metadata.remarks: Trusted Data is a composite pattern asserting that institutional data is properly defined, classified, governed, protected, retained, and defensibly disposed of. It introduces no independent controls and exists solely as an aggregate trust claim for system security plans, audits, and architectural risk analysis.
